lab summary <lab-dir> --role <role> --data-version <id> --config <run.json> --created-utc <ts> [--operator human|agent] [--notes <path>] [--force]

Write one deterministic summary.txt for a lab result folder.

Options
  --role <role>                researcher, developer, or validator; required.
  --data-version <id>          Caller-supplied identity; required.
  --config <path>              The run configuration; required.
  --created-utc <ts>           Explicit UTC time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; required.
  --operator <kind>            human or agent (default human).
  --notes <path>               Include role notes verbatim.
  --force                      Overwrite an existing summary.txt.

Output
  Writes <lab-dir>/summary.txt and prints wrote <path>.

Notes
  Reads the five report bundles and copies published values; it never recomputes the model.
  The data version must match every report.json and provenance.json.
  Never reads the clock; --created-utc is explicit.
  Refuses an existing summary.txt unless --force is given.
